_comment: A generic example. It describes nobody. Copy it to ~/.claude/i-have-audhd.json, replace every value with traits your own reader actually has, and keep that copy out of version control if it describes a real person. The injection half reads reader and traits. The enforcement half reads the optional enforcement object: mode (block | warn | off, unset = per-rule built-ins), judgeCommand (null = the five judge-gated rules are inactive and each fired trigger is logged to skipped.log), rules (per-rule mode overrides), and armOmp (true lets OMP seats block; absent or false keeps OMP seats at warn, and Claude Code ignores it). Configure a judge command that accepts the prompt on stdin and writes verdict JSON on stdout; verify it in your environment before enabling it. The command below is an example, not the default.
reader: the engineer who owns this service
traits: reads the first two lines of any message and skims the rest
wants the decision named before the reasoning that produced it
treats an unanswered question as answered unless it is the last line
